notes.title: Important update regarding the console versions and the DLC!
notes.content:
Greetings, survivors!

Today we have two new pieces of information to give to you.

First and foremost is that the DLC, Another Past, will be available on Steam through an update tomorrow, February 23rd at 17:00 GMT. We will be looking forward to your opinions and thoughts about the content of the DLC which we hope you enjoy!

The second piece of news is that the console versions coming out tomorrow for the Switch and Xbox will only contain the base game and the DLC will come at a later date through an update. This is due to an unexpected technical issue, so we beg you to be patient and enjoy the base game for now.

Thank you all and see you on the next adventure!

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
- Items now have an outline when you get close to them.
- Fixed the City's Map pickup description.
- Fixed other small issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
- Added new item "Leg Pouch" for people who take a long time to get an upgrade.
- Fixed issue where some people couldn't pick up the Stone Key.
- Fixed several out of bounds glitches.
- Reduced flashlight consumption.
- Fixed error in the shotgun's description.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Gameplay
- Fixed some first aid kits not restoring as they should.
- Challenge 03 has received some adjustments to be framerate independent.
- Made disc puzzle clues more obvious.
- Added clues for beating the Water Tank puzzle.
- Added more batteries for the Normal difficulty.
- Fixed small issues in Phase 3 of the final boss.

Options
- FPS Cap increased up to 360.
- Added unlimited FPS option. (Choose 0 in Framerate Cap)

Extras
- New content added to the Museum.

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.content:
- Fixed gamebreaking bug that prevented the final battle from being beaten.
- Challenges now unlocks when beating the game in normal. (Works retroactively by getting in the main menu if you have beaten the game.)

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Gameplay
- Made some puzzle items more visible.
- Adjusted ammo packs for some weapons.
- Adjusted weapon damage.
- Fixed issue where you could get blown away in final battle.
- Reduced general volume of a sound in final battle.

Settings
- Added an option to invert the Y axis camera movement when controlling the character.

Others
- Added version number to the title screen.

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
- Fixed some out of bounds issues.
- Corrected text in some textures that had some grammar issues.
- Corrected text for the water tank puzzle which had misleading number of crowns.

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the revolver and the pistol had the same description.
- Fixed issue where you couldn't die at the Doctor's house in the traps.

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
- Fixed small issues related to out of bounds glitches.
- Fixed the Paper puzzle being glitched.
